clue.text: Flora, being prudish, got up

parts.note: prim means prudish, stiffly proper
rose is the past tense of rise, so it means got up

explanation.surface: A woman named Flora, being prim, rose to her feet in disapproval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flora' looks like a woman's name, but it means flowers in general, and the answer is one particular flower.
explanation.definitionFit: A primrose is a pale yellow spring flower, so it belongs to flora, the plant life of a place.

clue.text: Scrutinise each benefit

parts.note: per means for each, as in a pound per head
use means benefit, as in of no use

explanation.surface: Examine every perk closely.
explanation.definitionFit: To peruse is to read or examine something carefully.

clue.text: The first person forming a band in West Africa

parts.note: I is the first person pronoun

indicators.note: forming means shaping into something new, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The man who started a music group in West Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forming' rearranges ABAND to BADAN after I.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibadan is a large city in Nigeria, which lies in West Africa.

clue.text: Standing about set point

parts.note: re means about, concerning
put means set, place
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A position held near the deciding point of a tennis match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set point' reads as a tennis term; split it into 'set' and 'point'.
explanation.definitionFit: Repute is reputation, one's standing in others' eyes.

clue.text: Still state guns may be turned on people

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above the next piece
turned round means read backwards, so the word for guns is reversed

parts.note: gats is slang for guns
a nation is a people

explanation.surface: Weapons might be aimed at the population of a calm country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be turned' reverses GATS to STAG; 'on' puts it above NATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Stagnation is a condition of no movement or progress, like stagnant water.

clue.text: A graduate copper's counting on this

parts.note: a BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper, and the 's adds an S

explanation.surface: A graduate police officer is relying on a particular tool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'copper' suggests a policeman; here it is the metal, symbol Cu. Its 's is kept as a letter S.
explanation.definitionFit: An abacus is a frame of beads slid along wires, used for doing arithmetic by hand.

clue.text: Stop a shoddy house builder

parts.note: a bung is a stopper, and to bung is to stop up
low means poor, shoddy

explanation.surface: Someone should halt a builder who puts up poor homes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'builder' plays no part in the wordplay; it rounds off the picture of a shoddy house builder.
explanation.definitionFit: A bungalow is a single-storey dwelling.

clue.text: Music man putting cheese into cleaner wrapping

indicators.note: into tells us the cheese goes inside the word for cleaner

parts.note: a char, or charwoman, is a cleaner
Brie is a soft French cheese

explanation.surface: A man puts cheese into the cleaner's wrapping.
explanation.walkthrough: A char is a British word for a cleaning lady. Emmanuel Chabrier was a French composer.
explanation.definitionFit: Chabrier was a nineteenth-century French composer, best known for España.

clue.text: Having to look over many fewer won't give one the pip

parts.note: to see is to look over, as a doctor sees a patient
D is the Roman numeral for 500, many
less means fewer

explanation.surface: Seeing over a much reduced number won't annoy anyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the pip' suggests being annoyed (British 'give someone the pip'); it means a fruit seed.
explanation.definitionFit: Seedless fruit contains no pips, so eating it you won't find one.

clue.text: Gather a certain fruit is to make a comeback

parts.note: to reap is to gather in a crop
a pear is one particular fruit

explanation.surface: Harvesting a pear crop marks a return to form.
explanation.definitionFit: To reappear is to show up again after being away, which is what a comeback is.

clue.text: Scrap in quarters to cause annoyance

indicators.note: in tells us the scrap goes inside the quarters

parts.note: E, N and E are compass points, the quarters of the compass
a rag is a scrap of cloth

explanation.surface: A fight breaking out in living quarters is bound to upset people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scrap' reads as a fight, but it is a scrap of cloth; 'quarters' are compass points, not lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrage is to make someone furious, a strong way to provoke irritation.

clue.text: Making an onset when taking off

explanation.surface: Something begins its attack just as it lifts into the air.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses mean beginning: launching an attack, and setting off or departing.

clue.text: Go round to watch a little group at roll-call

indicators.note: a little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Patrolling is the duty given to a small band of soldiers answering roll-call.
explanation.definitionFit: To patrol is to make the rounds of an area, keeping guard over it.

clue.text: Adjust rate and things should be different

indicators.note: the letters are made different by being rearranged

explanation.surface: Change the rate and everything will change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'should be different' rearranges RATE and THINGS together.
explanation.definitionFit: To straighten something is to put it right or set it in order.

clue.text: Tradesmen rent it so as to be flexible

indicators.note: something flexible bends into new shapes, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Shopkeepers lease out their premises on adaptable terms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be flexible' rearranges RENTITSOAS into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Stationers are shopkeepers who sell paper, pens and office supplies.

clue.text: Precocious, so got on

explanation.surface: A gifted child made fast progress.
explanation.definitionFit: Advanced means ahead of one's age, and also means moved forward, progressed.

clue.text: A translation of "Enmity"

parts.note: a version is a translation, as in the Authorised Version

explanation.surface: Someone offers their rendering of the word Enmity.
explanation.definitionFit: Aversion is strong dislike or hostility, close to enmity.

clue.text: Labs seem resolved to get together

indicators.note: something resolved is broken down and reformed, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The laboratories appear determined to merge.
explanation.definitionFit: To assemble is to gather in one place.

clue.text: Dream in the face of separation

indicators.note: in tells us the dream goes inside the face

parts.note: a dial is the face of a clock or watch
a vision is a dream

explanation.surface: Dreaming while confronted by a split.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the face of' reads as one phrase meaning 'confronted by'; split it, so 'in' places VISION inside DIAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Divisional means relating to division, that is, to splitting into parts.

clue.text: Pass bottle-opener-allowed one glass

parts.note: go means pass, as in time goes by

indicators.note: the opener of the word bottle is its first letter

parts.note: let means allowed

explanation.surface: Hand over the corkscrew, it's permitted to have one drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bottle-opener' reads as a corkscrew but means the first letter of 'bottle'.
explanation.definitionFit: A goblet is a drinking vessel with a stem and foot.

clue.text: The girl may well be a minor

indicators.note: the letters of a minor may well be rearranged into the answer

explanation.surface: The young woman is probably under age.
explanation.definitionFit: Marion is a girl's name.

clue.text: Position of a good man joining an establishment

annotationWithheld.clue: Position of a good man joining an establishment

clue.text: Song-writers serving in HM forces?

parts.note: a tune is an air; the forces sense is RAF personnel

explanation.definitionFit: Airmen are members of an air force; split, the word suggests men who write airs, or songs.

clue.text: Rang in to order without instruction

indicators.note: putting letters in order means arranging them afresh, so these are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone phoned in to place an order without being told how.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like a purchase but it rearranges RANGINTO.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone ignorant lacks knowledge, having had no teaching or schooling.

clue.text: About fifty-one medicos are to get rises

parts.note: C is short for circa, about
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
I is the Roman numeral for one
MBs are Bachelors of Medicine, doctors

explanation.surface: Around fifty-one doctors are due for pay increases.
explanation.definitionFit: Climbs and rises both mean upward movements or increases.

clue.text: It's all recklessly put on a horse

indicators.note: acting recklessly means acting wildly, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: the letters of it's all, ignoring the apostrophe
on means put on, as a show that is staged

explanation.surface: A gambler wildly stakes everything on one horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recklessly' rearranges ITSALL to STALLI, and ON follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A stallion is an uncastrated male horse.

clue.text: Dunderhead inside getting food late in the day

parts.note: the head, first letter, of Dunder
inner means inside

explanation.surface: A fool indoors eats his evening meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dunderhead' looks like a word for a fool; read it as the head of 'Dunder', its D.
explanation.definitionFit: Dinner is the main meal, usually eaten in the evening.

clue.text: Popular with 21 for example

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable
21 is the answer to 21 down, a word for position or posture

explanation.surface: A cross-reference to another clue offered as an illustration.
explanation.definitionFit: An instance is a case or example, so 'for instance' and 'for example' match.
